name: so101_reach_mujoco_wall_clock_v0
description: Wall-clock MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 reach benchmark with fixed target eval cases.
notes: Wall-clock benchmark for the MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 reach task.
Reach success mirrors the SO101-Nexus ReachConfig default success_threshold=0.02 m, with targets sampled from a 0.15 m half-extent 3D workspace around the task center.
